$comment: REQ-UX-001: teaching through play, with progressive disclosure — no tutorial dump. Each hint belongs to one screen and appears only while its condition holds and until the player dismisses it; a screen shows at most one hint at a time, the first in this list whose condition holds. Conditions are named in code (app/Guidance.ts) and checked at load. PENDING APPROVAL: wording and order.

hints.text: Pick a region and an objective. The Guild AI proposes a party and explains why — you decide, then the hunters act on their own.
Someone has unspent attribute points. Where you put them decides what kind of hunter they become — and how the AI plays them.
Shift-click (or Shift+Enter) a second hunter to compare two builds side by side.
The town is under pressure. The panel names which need is short; a building that answers it relieves it.
Nothing guards the walls. Attacks come while you are away; a watchtower and someone on gate watch hold them.
The stores are running down. A field kitchen or a hunting camp feeds more people than the granary alone.
The guild works while you are away. Set a standing order below if you want expeditions to go out without you.
Clients post work on the contract board. The Guild AI reads each offer; accepting is always yours.
You have Legacy points. They buy options and breadth for this guild and the next, never raw power.
